vent-cross-section

A cross-section through the chimney wall — a real 2-D FiPy finite-volume field, every pixel a solved cell. Cold acidic seawater bathes the outer wall (left); the hot alkaline serpentinized fluid percolates up the conduit (right). The gradient across the wall is the engine of the vent. Settled: 49 °C, pH 9.45 (the Lost City window).
